backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing required YES-click agreement text update in App.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Summaries of key frontend files including App, styles, Tailwind config, and confetti component.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind imports and CSS variable definitions for light/dark themes and layout primitives.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling screens, YES/NO interactions, agreement message, confetti, and moving NO button.
Generates and animates 80 randomized confetti pieces using CSS animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider managing Internet Identity login, storage, and state.
frontend/src/index.css: Custom romantic color palette, global styles, screen transitions, confetti effects, and floating hearts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point wiring QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom color variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and features for a romantic Valentine web page with interactive YES/NO behavior and responsive design notes.
